reviewCadence: At every frontend resource, API header, third-party script, iframe, style, telemetry endpoint, or reporting endpoint change.

requirements.name: Deliver CSP through HTTP headers
requirements.owasp: CSP is implemented via a response header and applied to all application responses.

controls.name: Centralized web CSP header builder
controls.description: All web applications build Content-Security-Policy headers from the shared web runtime helper instead of local string literals.

requirements.name: Restrict script execution
requirements.owasp: Prevent inline script execution, script attribute handlers, and unsafe JavaScript execution in production.

controls.name: Production script execution baseline
controls.description: Production web CSP allows scripts only from self and explicitly registered third-party origins; unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval are development-only.

requirements.name: Constrain resource loading
requirements.owasp: Restrict remote resources, connections, frames, workers, fonts, and images to application-approved sources.

controls.name: Explicit resource source registry
controls.description: Web CSP directives cover default, worker, style elements, React style attributes, images, fonts, connections, and frames. Runtime-generated style elements and attributes are allowed for the SPA component stack, while script execution remains strict and product-specific external sources stay allowlisted in each Vite config.

requirements.name: Block injection primitives and clickjacking
requirements.owasp: Deny object embedding, constrain base URI and form destinations, and prevent framing.

controls.name: Navigation and embedding restrictions
controls.description: Web and API CSP policies define object-src none, base-uri self, form-action self, and frame-ancestors none.

requirements.name: Apply a deny-by-default API policy
requirements.owasp: Non-document API responses should not load active content and should still emit a strict CSP.

controls.name: API denylist CSP
controls.description: Rust services emit a deny-by-default CSP that blocks scripts, styles, images, fonts, workers, frames, objects, media, and manifests.

requirements.name: Collect CSP violation telemetry
requirements.owasp: Use CSP reporting to detect policy bypasses, rollout regressions, and attempted injection.

controls.name: CSP reporting endpoint
controls.description: Policies report violations to /csp-report and the account service logs blocked URI, document URI, violated directive, effective directive, and source file.

requirements.name: Prevent CSP regressions
requirements.owasp: CSP controls must be reviewed and enforced as part of the repository security gate.

controls.name: CSP regression check
controls.description: The root check path validates registry evidence, shared CSP usage, required directives, no legacy CSP headers, and no unsafe production script sources.
